data.name: Najwat
data.gender_notes: Najwat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who comes early, before others. The name Najwat carries the meaning “Early Arriver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najwat usually hope their child will grow to embody early arriver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the desire to arrive at spiritual enlightenment before others.
data.etymology: Najwat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Early Arriver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najwat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: نجوۃ

in_english.name: Najwat
in_english.meaning: Najwat means elevation, highness, or spiritual ascension
in_english.long_meaning: Najwat is an Arabic name derived from the root 'n-j-w' which signifies elevation, highness, or spiritual ascension. In Islamic tradition, this name holds spiritual significance and connotes a sense of moral and ethical elevation. Historically, names like Najwat have been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing aspirations for spiritual growth and higher moral standing.
